patches.name: Offline microphone
patches.description: Embeds a whisper.cpp offline speech engine and adds an Offline mic panel inside the keyboard. Choose Khmer, English, Thai or Chinese; tap Download model once (142 MiB shared multilingual model), then dictate without internet. No Google app or external speech provider required. Also redirects SwiftKey's Android SpeechRecognizer path; Microsoft Azure voice typing is not modified.

patches.name: Text editing toolbar
patches.description: Adds a collapsible text editing toolbar inside the keyboard: cursor arrows, Home/End, selection, Select all, Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo and Redo. Actions use the current editor; Undo/Redo depend on that app's support. Does not change login, telemetry or Google services.
